text: The steps for students to register using a class number are: (1) go to Galaxy, click on "Orion" and log in with your NetID and password; (2) in your UTD Student Center, select the "Manage My Classes" tile; (3) select 'Swap Classes' and then click on 'Add'; (4) select the term and click 'Continue'; (5) enter the class number or search to find the class; (6) if it is a variable class, select how many semester credit hours you are taking the class for and then click on 'Next'; (7) once you are done adding classes, click on 'Proceed to Step 2 of 3'; and (8) confirm your enrollment and click on 'Finish Enrolling'. You should receive a green check mark in the status field and a message that the class was successfully added to your schedule.
